_meta.indication: TRULANCE is a guanylate cyclase-C agonist indicated in adults for treatment of chronic idiopathic constipation (CIC).

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, 12-week study with 1:1:1 randomization to 3 mg plecanatide, 6 mg plecanatide, or placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients (18 to 80 years, inclusive) meeting the modified Rome III functional constipation criteria
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of patients who were durable overall CSBM responders over the 12-week Treatment Period
pivotal_trials.result: Durable overall CSBM responders (ITT, MRA): 21.0% for 3 mg plecanatide vs 10.2% placebo (p < 0.001)

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, 12-week study with 1:1:1 randomization to 3 mg plecanatide, 6 mg plecanatide, or placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients (18 to 80 years, inclusive) meeting the modified Rome III functional constipation criteria
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of patients who were durable overall CSBM responders over the 12-week Treatment Period
pivotal_trials.result: Durable overall CSBM responders: 20.5% for 3 mg plecanatide vs 13.0% placebo; treatment difference 7.5% (95% CI 2.6%, 12.5%; p = 0.003)

key_safety: Most common adverse reaction (≥2%) was diarrhea (5% TRULANCE 3 mg vs 1% placebo). Severe diarrhea occurred in 0.6% of TRULANCE-treated patients vs 0.3% placebo. Discontinuations due to adverse reactions occurred in 4% of TRULANCE-treated vs 2% placebo, most commonly due to diarrhea (2% vs 0.5%).
target_moa: Plecanatide is structurally related to human uroguanylin and functions as a guanylate cyclase-C (GC-C) agonist; activation of GC-C increases intracellular and extracellular cGMP, stimulating chloride and bicarbonate secretion into the intestinal lumen.

boxed_warning.content: TRULANCE is contraindicated in patients less than 6 years of age (deaths due to dehydration in young juvenile mice); avoid use in patients 6 years to less than 18 years of age.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held to discuss this NDA as there were no issues that required discussion at an AC meeting.

description.text: Added indication for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application proposes a new indication for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C).

summary.text: Standard review NDA for plecanatide (Trulance), a guanylate cyclase-C agonist, submitted and received January 29, 2016 and approved January 29, 2017 for chronic idiopathic constipation in adults, with no advisory committee meeting and no accelerated-approval or expedited-program designations; the approval carries a Boxed Warning and required pediatric and immunogenicity postmarketing studies.
